business_problem: BBVA wanted customers in Italy and Germany to access and compare information about its banking products and services through a natural-language conversational channel without leaving ChatGPT.
solution_summary: BBVA implemented a customer-facing conversational experience by making its BBVA app available inside ChatGPT for users in Italy and Germany. In this deployment, ChatGPT serves as the entry point where customers ask questions in natural language, while the BBVA app handles informational queries about the bank’s local digital offerings, including accounts, cards, and savings products. The app returns personalized responses inside the chat and exposes follow-on interaction patterns such as exploring other products and related questions and answers. The experience also links users directly from the conversation to relevant BBVA product pages on the bank’s website, connecting conversational discovery to the bank’s owned digital channels. The source does not describe backend storage or model architecture, but it clearly shows an implemented OpenAI-powered serving layer integrated with BBVA’s digital banking content for Germany and Italy.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Provides the conversational interface where users discover and interact with the BBVA app in natural language.

solution_components.name: BBVA app
solution_components.role: Answers questions about BBVA products in Italy and Germany and returns direct links to relevant product pages.

data_flow: Users in Italy or Germany open ChatGPT, connect the BBVA app, and submit natural-language questions about banking products. The BBVA app generates personalized answers inside the conversation and sends users to relevant BBVA website pages through direct product links.
integration_points: BBVA digital banks in Italy and Germany
business_outcome: BBVA launched a new conversational banking channel inside ChatGPT so customers can explore product information more naturally and access BBVA offerings through channels they already use.
